text:
nadia (BillingOps): Heads-up 2 invoices showing unexpected total amounts in NetSuite vs Stripe. Discrepancy looks like unit_price multiplied by 100 for a subset of line items.

owen (Eng): investigating. There was a small change in the pricing-experiments branch that added a helper to normalize prices, intended to convert minor units -> major. Looks like the helper was applied twice for invoices with `pricing_experiment: override-v2`.

li (Finance): If totals doubled for those line items we need to correct revenue recognition and possibly issue corrected invoices. How many customers affected?

nadia (BillingOps): 12 invoices across 5 customers, created between 2025-03-02T13:05Z and 13:18Z. Affected lines are only experimental promo lines (metadata `pricing_experiment`).

repo-bot: [ALERT] 12 invoice line mismatches detected (unit_price scaling) since 2025-03-02T13:05Z. See /alerts/9218.

owen (Eng): root cause: the mapper pipeline runs normalize_prices() at both `stripe->intermediate` and again at `intermediate->ns` for experiment routes. For non-experiment routes the second call is skipped. Quick fix: make normalize_prices idempotent (detect already-normalized flag) and patch mapper to not re-run on ns path. Deploying hotfix to staging.

li (Finance): For backfill, we must only adjust the experimental line items and leave invoice numbers/payments unchanged. Also we need a memo for audit.

owen (Eng): Backfill plan: idempotent upsert by external_id, recalc affected line totals by dividing unit_price by 100 where `metadata.pricing_experiment` present and add memo `CORR: pricing-expt scaling`. Dry-run first. Command: `./tools/ns_line_fix --ids /tmp/pricing_bad_ids.txt --dry-run --fields lines`

nadia (BillingOps): share sample transformed payload from dry-run for finance to validate.

owen (Eng): sample dry-run payload:

```
external_id: stripe_inv_X7, customer_external_id: cus_51, lines: [ {desc: "promo credits", quantity: 1, unit_price: 2500, currency: "USD", metadata: {pricing_experiment: "override-v2"}} ], metadata: {pricing_experiment: "override-v2"}
```

owen (Eng): In dry-run, corrected payload will set unit_price=25 and total_line_amount=25. No duplicate invoices created.

li (Finance): sample good. After full backfill we'll validate revenue buckets and run AR vs Stripe totals. If any cash impact, we'll prepare adjusting journals.

nadia (BillingOps): action items: (1) owen deploy hotfix to prod (done), (2) owen run dry-run and then full backfill in 30m, (3) li validate GLs and OK external comms if any.

owen (Eng): running dry-run now (2025-03-02T13:35Z). Will post results and then run full backfill with `--audit-log /backfills/pricing_scaling_fix.log`.

repo-bot: [BACKFILL] dry-run: 12 candidates. 

owen (Eng): full backfill complete: 12 invoices updated, no duplicates. Audit: /backfills/pricing_scaling_fix.log

li (Finance): spot-checked GLs and confirmed revenue recognition corrected for the 12 invoices. Preparing memo for month-end close.

nadia (BillingOps): closing thread. Add unit-test to ensure normalize_prices is idempotent and add alert if unit_price > 10000 (safety net).
